tokens.font.body: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji", sans-serif
tokens.font.heading: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji", sans-serif

layer.css:
[data-ryt="button"] { color: rgb(49, 65, 88); background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.949); border-top: 1px solid rgb(202, 213, 226); border-right: 1px solid rgb(202, 213, 226); border-bottom: 1px solid rgb(202, 213, 226); border-left: 1px solid rgb(202, 213, 226); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0) 0px 0px 0px 0px, rgba(20, 20, 39, 0.051) 0px 0px 0px 1px, rgba(202, 212, 225, 0.302) 0px 20px 25px -5px, rgba(202, 212, 225, 0.302) 0px 8px 10px -6px; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: normal; text-transform: none; text-decoration-style: solid; text-decoration-color: rgb(49, 65, 88); text-decoration-thickness: auto; text-underline-offset: auto; padding-top: 0px; padding-right: 0px; padding-bottom: 0px; padding-left: 0px; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); transition: 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) }
[data-ryt="hero"] h1 { color: var(--ryt-accent); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Noto Color Emoji"; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; font-style: normal; line-height: 1.4; letter-spacing: -0.5px; text-transform: none; text-decoration-style: solid; text-decoration-color: var(--ryt-accent); text-decoration-thickness: auto; text-underline-offset: auto; transition: all }
